groups.problem: absolutize_urls rewrites protocol-relative URLs ('//cdn...') into broken site-relative URLs.
groups.rationale: Both describe the same start_with?('/') check mangling '//' URLs in absolutize_urls, and both propose the same fix.

groups.problem: Host comparison against embeddable_host is case-sensitive, so mixed-case hosts are wrongly rejected.
groups.rationale: The same case-sensitive host comparison appears in embed_controller.rb and topic_retriever.rb, and S15 says it applies to both. One approach (downcasing both sides) fixes each place.

problems: Imported HTML is stored as raw_html and rendered with raw, skipping the sanitizer (stored XSS).
The url is put into the href without escaping.
uncoveredProblems: Imported feed/remote HTML is not sanitized before being stored as raw_html and rendered raw (stored XSS).
The url is interpolated into the imported-from link without escaping (also reported by S8, which has no group).

problems: The Disqus import drops the category option and the thread's created_at date.
The live HTTP fetch via open(url) can raise and abort the whole import, so fetch errors need to be rescued per thread.
uncoveredProblems: The Disqus import no longer applies the category and created_at.
Fetch failures in import_remote abort the whole Disqus import.
